working.title: The main lead reel
working.body: One reel brought 396 of October's 468 Meta leads. It's the cheapest way we have to reach a new parent.

working.title: Instagram is growing
working.body: Instagram account follows rose 60% on September, helped by the ads.

working.title: Campus moments travel furthest
working.body: The Pakaashala kitchen reel reached 10.9K people and brought 58 new followers, the best post of the month.

working.title: Proud moments
working.body: The Principal's Times School feature and the Taekwondo gold reached far more people than an ordinary static post.

working.title: Parents passed posts on
working.body: Up 5% on September with fewer posts, so each post was shared or saved more often.

notWorking.title: Warm leads to campus visits
notWorking.body: 756 October leads are Interested or waiting on a call back. A campus-visit drive starts with the 44 warm leads who missed a booked visit and the 240 call-backs older than 14 days.

notWorking.title: Faster replies to parents
notWorking.body: About 1 in 10 Instagram messages got a reply in October, after 1 hour 47 minutes on average. Replying within the hour turns more of these conversations into admission leads.

notWorking.title: Budget back to the best ad
notWorking.body: A two-day test of grade-specific ads (Grades 3–5, Nursery–PP2) brought 44 leads. The main lead reel stays far cheaper, so November's budget goes there.

notWorking.title: Reach per post held steady
notWorking.body: Unpaid reach was 36.8K. Fewer posts went out than in September, but each post reached about as many people (2.6K vs 2.7K).

notWorking.title: Cleaner Google traffic
notWorking.body: 110 cancelled leads were job-seekers. Job-related negative keywords (jobs, vacancy, teacher, careers) keep ad spend on parents.

decisions.text: Run a campus-visit drive this week on warm leads, starting with the 44 missed visits and 240 older call-backs.
Reply to every Instagram and WhatsApp message within an hour, including weekends.
Move the grade-band budget to the main lead reel until a new version beats ₹100 a lead.
Add job-related negative keywords and switch on Google Search ads for 'CBSE school Kukatpally'.
Send reel footage by the due date so every planned reel goes out.
